reuse.why: Adds the guard to the existing shared linkBankAccount pipeline, next to assertNotAlreadyLinked, so every provider's link handler gets it.

duplication.why: No duplicated logic; the guard does re-read the upgrading account row that saveLinkedAccount reads again later, a small redundant query.

placement.why: A validation helper in accounts/app.ts called at the top of linkBankAccount, mirroring the existing assertNotAlreadyLinked.

scope.why: Only the guard, one test and a release note.

maintainability.why: A small, named precondition in the one link path that is easy to find and change.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The check is inside the shared linkBankAccount used by all *-accounts-link handlers.

one_place.where: assertNotClosed called from linkBankAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, the single path all provider link handlers use.
